description: City Circle tram route is a dataset listed in Australian national open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by City of Melbourne. The City Circle tram service operates within Melbourne's central business district. The service operates in a circular route passing major tourist attractions, as well as linking with other tram, train and bus routes in and around Melbourne. This maps shows the location of the stops on the route. Coverage: City of Melbourne. The portal files it under the publisher City of Melbourne. Its tags are accessibility, city-circle, tourism, tourist, tram. It offers 6 resource(s) in CSV, GEOJSON, JSON, KML, SHP. The portal shows 2025-06-25 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is other open licence as labelled on the portal (terms not stated). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-au-portal.
